sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspaces" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "aliases" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "counts_in_buckets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("counts_in_buckets" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('cash', 'bank', 'savings', 'custom')), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "locale_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ar', "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dark', "lock_timeout_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 300, "biometric_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("biometric_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IQD', "setup_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("setup_completed" IN (0, 1)), "last_backup_at" INTEGER NULL, "ai_online_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("ai_online_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "ai_voice_consent" TEXT NULL CHECK("ai_voice_consent" IN ('granted', 'declined')), "ai_parse_consent" TEXT NULL CHECK("ai_parse_consent" IN ('granted', 'declined')), "groq_stt_model" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whisper-large-v3-turbo', "groq_llm_model" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', "local_whisper_model" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'small' CHECK("local_whisper_model" IN ('small', 'base')), "unallocated_income_alert" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unallocated_income_alert" IN (0, 1)), "buckets_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("buckets_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "vault_auto_lock_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120 CHECK("vault_auto_lock_seconds" IN (60, 120, 300, 600)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_metadata" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('export', 'restore')), "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('income', 'expense')), "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "workspace_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "extra_keywords" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), CHECK (system_key IS NOT NULL OR name IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "base_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_e6" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rate_e6" > 0), "effective_from" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("base_code", "quote_code", "effective_from"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "undone_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("direction" IN ('owed_to_me', 'owed_by_me')), "counterparty" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "principal_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("principal_minor" > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "debt_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES debts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('income', 'expense', 'transfer', 'adjustment', 'refund', 'debt_payment')), "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "workspace_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_account_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "to_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "rate_e6" INTEGER NULL, "transfer_kind" TEXT NULL CHECK("transfer_kind" IN ('transfer', 'owner_draw')), "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bucket_tag" TEXT NULL CHECK("bucket_tag" IN ('emergency', 'investment')), "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paid' CHECK("payment_status" IN ('paid', 'pending')), "debt_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES debts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "debt_leg" TEXT NULL CHECK("debt_leg" IN ('principal', 'repayment')), "import_batch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "capture_id" INTEGER NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (amount_minor > 0 OR (type = 'adjustment' AND amount_minor <> 0)), CHECK ((type = 'transfer') = (to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_amount_minor IS NOT NULL AND transfer_kind IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (type = 'transfer' OR rate_e6 IS NULL), CHECK (to_amount_minor IS NULL OR to_amount_minor > 0), CHECK (rate_e6 IS NULL OR rate_e6 > 0), CHECK (bucket_tag IS NULL OR type = 'expense'), CHECK ((type = 'debt_payment') = (debt_id IS NOT NULL AND debt_leg IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "buckets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "percent_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("percent_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "target_minor" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bucket_allocations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "transaction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "bucket_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES buckets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_base_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_base_minor" > 0), "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_e6_used" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "workspace_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (category_id IS NOT NULL OR workspace_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "captures" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('voice', 'text')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('pending', 'done', 'discarded')), "audio" BLOB NULL, "transcript" TEXT NULL, "parsed_json" TEXT NULL, "parsed_by" TEXT NULL CHECK("parsed_by" IN ('ai', 'rules')), "failure_type" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "vault_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "check_blob" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_key_wraps" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('password', 'recovery')) UNIQUE, "kdf_json" TEXT NULL, "salt" BLOB NOT NULL, "sealed_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK ((kind = 'password') = (kdf_json IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "username" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("category" IN ('personal', 'business', 'social', 'banking', 'hosting', 'domain', 'email', 'marketing', 'dev', 'other')), "workspace_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "password_blob" BLOB NULL, "notes_blob" BLOB NULL, "recovery_codes_blob" BLOB NULL, "password_changed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meeting_notes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "workspace_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "workspace_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK("priority" IN ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo' CHECK("status" IN ('todo', 'doing', 'done')), "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "due_all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("due_all_day" IN (0, 1)), "remind_at" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL CHECK("recurrence" IS NULL OR "recurrence" IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly')), "recurrence_interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("recurrence_interval" BETWEEN 1 AND 365), "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "capture_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES captures (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "meeting_note_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES meeting_notes (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX tx_account_time ON transactions (account_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX tx_time ON transactions (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX tx_batch ON transactions (import_batch_id)
CREATE INDEX vault_item_title ON vault_items (title)
CREATE INDEX task_due ON tasks (due_at)
CREATE INDEX task_parent ON tasks (parent_id)
